counterfactual_missing_items: lack of systemic symptoms and negative serologies for lymphoma
absence of uptake in the adrenal glands on PET/CT
decisive_items: Testicular ultrasound showed enlargement and inhomogeneity of the right testis and epididymis
An 18 FDG PET/CT showed intense uptake (SUVmax 25.5) in the right testis
response.rationale: The patient's age, imaging findings, and intense uptake on PET/CT are consistent with testicular lymphoma, making it the most likely diagnosis. The lack of systemic symptoms and negative serologies also support this diagnosis.

rejected.why: lack of FDG uptake in adrenal glands on PET/CT makes primary adrenal lymphoma less likely
no clear evidence of metastatic cancer
primary adrenal macronodular hyperplasia does not explain testicular pathology
